46: /*
47:  * Coexistence netif wire id (2-bit co_hdr.vif_idx). Roles are NOT pinned to a
48:  * fixed LMAC VIF index any more (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1 so the MCC
49:  * channel scheduler can handle them). We therefore key the wire id off the
50:  * (netif type, p2p) role instead of the LMAC index:
51:  *
52:  *   wire 0 = infra STA   (STA-type, !p2p) -> host g_mlan
53:  *   wire 1 = SoftAP      (AP-type,  !p2p) -> host g_uap
54:  *   wire 2 = P2P GO      (AP-type,   p2p) -> host g_p2p_go
55:  *   wire 3 = P2P GC      (STA-type,  p2p) -> host g_p2p_gc
56:  *
57:  * The TX path is symmetric: host tags the wire id, CP maps it back to the
58:  * current LMAC VIF index via cif_wire_to_lmac_vif() (no longer identity).
59:  */
60: static uint8_t cif_vif_to_netif_wire(void *vif)
61: {
62:     netif_if_t t = wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif);
63:     bool p2p = cif_vif_is_p2p(vif);
64: 
65:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_AP) && p2p)
66:         return 2;
67:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_STA) && p2p)
68:         return 3;
69: 
70:     return (uint8_t)t;
71: }
72: 
73: /*
74:  * Reverse of cif_vif_to_netif_wire(): map a host wire id back to the LMAC VIF
75:  * index currently held by that role. Since GO/GC float on vif0/vif1, the old
76:  * identity mapping (wire==index) no longer holds, so look the role up in the
77:  * active VIF table. Falls back to the wire id if no active match is found.
78:  */
79: static uint8_t cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(uint8_t wire)
80: {
81:     netif_if_t want_type;
82:     bool want_p2p;
83: 
84:     switch (wire)
85:     {
86:         case 0: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = false; break;
87:         case 1: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = false; break;
88:         case 2: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = true;  break;
89:         case 3: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = true;  break;
90:         default: return wire;
91:     }
92: 
93:     for (void *vif = mac_vif_mgmt_first_vif(); vif != NULL;
94:          vif = mac_vif_mgmt_next_vif(vif))
95:     {
96:         if ((wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif) == want_type) &&
97:             (cif_vif_is_p2p(vif) == want_p2p))
98:             return wifi_netif_vif_to_vifid(vif);
99:     }
100: 
101:     return wire;
102: }

111:     if ((sta_vif_id != INVALID_VIF_IDX) && (sap_vif_id != INVALID_VIF_IDX))
112:     {
113:         vif = mac_vif_mgmt_get_entry(sta_vif_id);
114:         if (vif)
115:             ap_id = mac_vif_mgmt_get_u_sta_ap_id(vif);
116: 
117:         if (ap_id != INVALID_STA_IDX)
118:         {
119:             return sta_vif_id + 0xF;
120:         }
121:         else
122:         {
123:             return sap_vif_id + 0xF;
124:         }
125:     }
126:     else if ((sta_vif_id != INVALID_VIF_IDX) && (sap_vif_id == INVALID_VIF_IDX))
127:     {
128:         return sta_vif_id + 0xF;
129:     }
130:     else if ((sta_vif_id == INVALID_VIF_IDX) && (sap_vif_id != INVALID_VIF_IDX))
131:     {
132:         return sap_vif_id + 0xF;
133:     }
134: 
135:     return INVALID_VIF_IDX;
136: }

138: bk_err_t cif_handle_txdata(void *head)
139: {
140:     uint8_t ret = BK_OK;
141:     struct pbuf* pbuf = NULL;
142: 
143:     cpdu_t* cpdu = (cpdu_t*)head;
144:     /* Map the host wire id (0..3) to the LMAC VIF index this role currently
145:      * holds (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1), then tag it with the +0xF offset
146:      * the downstream TX path expects. */
147:     uint8_t vif_id = cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(cpdu->co_hdr.vif_idx) + 0xF;
148:     BK_ASSERT(vif_id < 19);
149: #if CONFIG_BK_RAW_LINK
150:     if (cpdu->co_hdr.special_type == TX_RAW_LINK_TYPE)
151:     {
152:         struct ctrl_cmd_hdr *cpdu = (struct ctrl_cmd_hdr*)head;
153:         uint32_t align_mac_len = CIF_RAW_LINK_MEM_ALIGN_SIZE(RLK_WIFI_MAC_ADDR_LEN);
154: 
155:         if (cpdu->msg_hdr.id == RLK_TX_SEND_EVT)
156:         {
157:              ret = bk_rlk_send((uint8_t *)head + sizeof(struct ctrl_cmd_hdr), 
158:                     (uint8_t *)head + sizeof(struct ctrl_cmd_hdr) + align_mac_len, cpdu->co_hdr.length);
159: 
160:             cpdu->co_hdr.special_type = TX_RLK_FREE_MEM_TYPE;
161:             // Notify AP side to free memory instead of freeing on CP side
162:             cif_send_mem_free_req(head);
163:         }
164: 
165:         return ret;
166:     }
167: #endif
168: 
169:     pbuf = (struct pbuf*)((uint8_t*)head - sizeof(struct pbuf));
170: #if CONFIG_CONTROLLER_RX_DIRECT_PSH
171:     if(cpdu->co_hdr.need_free)
172:     {
173:         cif_stats_ptr->cif_rxc_cnt++;
174:         CIF_LOGV("%s free p:%x,p->ref:%d\r\n",__func__, pbuf,pbuf->ref);
175:         pbuf->ref--;
176:         pbuf_free(pbuf);
177:         return BK_OK;
178:     }
179: #endif
180: 
181:     CIF_STATS_INC(buf_in_txdata);
182:     cif_stats_ptr->cif_tx_cnt++;
183:     CIF_LOGV("%s p:%x next:%x payload%x sizeof:%d\r\n",__func__, pbuf, pbuf->next, pbuf->payload, sizeof(struct pbuf));
184:     CIF_LOGV("%s p:%x,vif_id=%d\r\n",__func__, pbuf,vif_id);
185: 
186: #if CONFIG_CONTROLLER_DEBUG
187:     TRACK_PBUF_ALLOC(pbuf);
188: #endif
189: 
190: #if CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY
191:     /*
192:      * In bridge mode AP-side bridgeif_send_to_port() already pbuf_clone's into
193:      * a PBUF_RAW_TX TX-headroom buffer (see bridgeif.c:1386). Cloning again on
194:      * CP wastes ~1.5KB heap per frame and serializes TX. Skip the second clone
195:      * when bridge is ENABLED and pass the pbuf to bmsg_tx_sender directly.
196:      */
197: #if CONFIG_BRIDGE
198:     if (bk_wifi_get_bridge_state() == BRIDGE_STATE_ENABLED)
199:     {
200:         ret = bmsg_tx_sender(pbuf, vif_id);
201:         if (ret != BK_OK)
202:         {
203:             cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
204:             ret = false;
205:         }
206:         return ret;
207:     }
208: #endif
209: 
210:     struct pbuf* p_copy = pbuf_clone(PBUF_RAW_TX,PBUF_RAM,pbuf);
211: 
212:     if((p_copy == NULL) || (p_copy->payload == NULL))
213:     {
214:         cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
215:         return BK_OK;
216:     }
217: 
218:     memcpy((void*)(p_copy+1),(void*)(pbuf+1),sizeof(cpdu_t));
219:     cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
220:     ret = bmsg_tx_sender(p_copy, vif_id);
221: 
222:     if(ret != BK_OK)
223:     {
224:         //CIF_LOGE("%s %d,p:0x%x\r\n",__func__,__LINE__,p_copy);
225:         pbuf_free(p_copy);
226:     }
227: 
228: #else
229:     ret = bmsg_tx_sender(pbuf, vif_id);
230:     if(ret != BK_OK)
231:     {
232:         cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
233:         ret = false;
234:     }
235: #endif
236:     return ret;
237: }

293: bool cif_filter_check_ip_data(struct pbuf *p)
294: {
295:     bool upload2ctrl = false;
296:     u16_t iphdr_hlen;
297: //	u16_t iphdr_len;
298:     uint32_t dest_port=0;
299:     uint32_t src_port=0;
300: 
301:     struct ip_hdr *iphdr;
302:     struct udp_hdr *udphdr;
303:     struct tcp_hdr *tcphdr;
304:     struct icmp_echo_hdr *iecho;
305:     if ((p->len <= SIZEOF_ETH_HDR) )//|| pbuf_header(p, (s16_t)-SIZEOF_ETH_HDR)) 
306:     {
307:         BK_ASSERT(0);
308:         return 0;
309:     }
310:     //stack_mem_dump((uint32_t)p->payload,(uint32_t)p->payload + 300);
311:     iphdr = (struct ip_hdr *)(p->payload + SIZEOF_ETH_HDR);
312:     
313:     /* obtain IP header length in number of 32-bit words */
314:     iphdr_hlen = IPH_HL(iphdr);
315:     /* calculate IP header length in bytes */
316:     iphdr_hlen *= 4;
317:   
318:     /* obtain ip length in bytes */
319: //	iphdr_len = lwip_ntohs(IPH_LEN(iphdr));
320:   
321:     CIF_LOGV("iphdr_hlen=%d,p->len=%d,p->tot_len=%d,IP_HLEN=%d\n",iphdr_hlen,p->len,p->tot_len,IP_HLEN);
322:     CIF_LOGV("IP RX dest_port = 0x%x\n",dest_port);
323: //   /* header length exceeds first pbuf length, or ip length exceeds total pbuf length? */
324: //   if ((iphdr_hlen > p->len) || (iphdr_len > p->tot_len) || (iphdr_hlen < IP_HLEN)) 
325: //   {
326: // 	BK_ASSERT(0);
327: // 	 return 0;
328: //   }
329: #if CONFIG_BRIDGE
330:     if (bk_wifi_get_bridge_state() == BRIDGE_STATE_ENABLED) {
331:         upload2ctrl = false;
332:         return upload2ctrl;
333:     }
334: #endif
335: 
336:   switch (IPH_PROTO(iphdr)) 
337:   {
338:      case IP_PROTO_UDP:
339:          udphdr = (struct udp_hdr *)(p->payload+(s16_t)iphdr_hlen+SIZEOF_ETH_HDR);
340:          dest_port=lwip_ntohs(udphdr->dest);
341:          src_port=lwip_ntohs(udphdr->src);
342:          CIF_LOGV("IP_PROTO_UDP dest_port:%d,src:%d\r\n",dest_port,src_port);
343:          upload2ctrl = cif_filter_check_ip_and_port(iphdr, src_port, dest_port);
344:          break;
345: 
346:      case IP_PROTO_TCP:
347:          tcphdr = (struct tcp_hdr *)(p->payload+(s16_t)iphdr_hlen+SIZEOF_ETH_HDR);
348:          dest_port=lwip_ntohs(tcphdr->dest);
349:          src_port=lwip_ntohs(tcphdr->src);
350:          CIF_LOGV("IP_PROTO_TCP port:%d\r\n",dest_port);
351:          upload2ctrl = cif_filter_check_ip_and_port(iphdr, src_port, dest_port);
352:          //BK_LOGD(NULL,"RX TCP src_ip:%x, src_port:%d\n", iphdr->src.addr, src_port);
353:          break;
354: 
355:     case IP_PROTO_ICMP:
356:         iecho = (struct icmp_echo_hdr *)((p->payload+(s16_t)iphdr_hlen+SIZEOF_ETH_HDR));
357:         if (iecho->type == ICMP_ECHO)
358:         {
359:             upload2ctrl = true;
360:         }
361:         else if (2 == get_ping_state()) //PING_STATE_STARTED
362:         {
363:             upload2ctrl = true;
364:         }
365:         else
366:         {
367:             upload2ctrl = false;
368:         }
369:         CIF_LOGV("IP_PROTO_ICMP,%p\r\n",p->payload);
370:         break;
371: 
372:     case IP_PROTO_IGMP:
373:         upload2ctrl = false;
374:         CIF_LOGV("IP_PROTO_IGMP\r\n");
375:         break; 
376:      default:
377:          break;
378:     }
379:     CIF_LOGV("%s %d dest_port = %d\r\n",__func__,__LINE__,dest_port);
380: 
381:     return upload2ctrl;
382: }

829:     struct bk_msg_hdr *msg = NULL;
830:     cpdu_t* hdr = (cpdu_t*)head;
831:     void* cmd = (void *)((struct cpdu_t*)head + 1);

833: 
834:     if(hdr->co_hdr.is_buf_bank)
835:     {
836:         cif_save_buffer_addr(head);
837:         return BK_OK;
838:     }
839: 
840:

842:     {
843:         CIF_LOGE("cif_handle_bk_cmd INVALID paramter cmd:%x\n", cmd);
844:         BK_ASSERT(0);
845:     }
846: 
847:     msg = (struct bk_msg_hdr *)cmd;
848: 
849:     CIF_LOGV("cif_handle_bk_cmd cmd_id:%x\n", msg->cmd_id);
850:     cif_env.no_host = false;
851:     cif_env.host_wifi_init = true;
852: 
853:     if ((msg->cmd_id >= BK_CMD_WIFI_API_START) && (msg->cmd_id < BK_CMD_WIFI_API_END))

98: bk_err_t bk_wdrv_get_mac(uint8_t *mac, mac_type_t type)
99: {
100:     uint8_t mac_mask = (0xff & (2/*NX_VIRT_DEV_MAX*/ - 1));
101:     uint8_t mac_low;
102: 
103:     if (wdrv_get_mac_addr() != 0)
104:     {
105:         WDRV_LOGE("bk_wdrv_get_mac  failed\n");
106:         return BK_FAIL;
107:     }
108: 
109:     switch (type) {
110:     case MAC_TYPE_BASE:
111:         memcpy(mac, wdrv_host_env.macaddr_cfm.mac_addr, BK_MAC_ADDR_LEN);
112:         break;
113: 
114:     case MAC_TYPE_AP:
115:         mac_mask = (0xff & (2/*NX_VIRT_DEV_MAX*/ - 1));
116: 
117:         memcpy(mac, wdrv_host_env.macaddr_cfm.mac_addr, BK_MAC_ADDR_LEN);
118:         mac_low = mac[5];
119: 
120:         // if  NX_VIRT_DEV_MAX == 4.
121:         // if support AP+STA, mac addr should be equal with each other in byte0-4 & byte5[7:2],
122:         // byte5[1:0] can be different
123:         // ie: mac[5]= 0xf7,  so mac[5] can be 0xf4, f5, f6. here wre chose 0xf4
124:         mac[5] &= ~mac_mask;
125:         mac_low = ((mac_low & mac_mask) ^ mac_mask);
126:         mac[5] |= mac_low;
127:         break;
128: 
129:     case MAC_TYPE_STA:
130:         memcpy(mac, wdrv_host_env.macaddr_cfm.mac_addr, BK_MAC_ADDR_LEN);
131:         break;
132: 
133:     default:
134:         return BK_ERR_INVALID_MAC_TYPE;
135:     }
136: 
137:     return BK_OK;
138: }

374:                       uint8_t *response_buf, uint16_t response_buf_size, uint16_t *response_len)
375: {
376:     int ret = 0;
377:     cifd_cust_msg_hdr_t *cust_trans = NULL;
378:     struct wdrv_customer_req cust_req = {0};
379:     wdrv_cmd_cfm cmd_cfm = {0};
380:     uint32_t total_len = 0;
381: 
382:     if (response_buf == NULL || response_len == NULL) {
383:         WIFI_LOGE("%s : Invalid response parameters\n", __func__);
384:         return BK_ERR_PARAM;
385:     }
386: 
387:     total_len = sizeof(cifd_cust_msg_hdr_t) + (data ? len : 0);
388:     cust_trans = os_malloc(total_len);
389:     if (cust_trans == NULL) {
390:         WIFI_LOGE("%s : malloc failed\n", __func__);
391:         return BK_ERR_NO_MEM;
392:     }
393: 
394:     cust_trans->cmd_id = cmd_id;
395:     cust_trans->len = len;
396:     if (data && len > 0) {
397:         os_memcpy(cust_trans->payload, data, len);
398:     }
399: 
400:     cust_req.cmd_hdr.cmd_id = BK_CMD_CUSTOMER_DATA;
401:     cust_req.cmd_hdr.len = total_len;
402:     cmd_cfm.waitcfm = WDRV_CMD_WAITCFM;
403:     cmd_cfm.cfm_id = 0;
404: 
405:     os_memcpy(cust_req.data, (uint8_t*)cust_trans, total_len);
406: 
407:     ret = wdrv_tx_msg((uint8_t *)&cust_req, sizeof(wdrv_cmd_hdr) + total_len, &cmd_cfm, response_buf);
408: 
409:     os_free(cust_trans);
410: 
411:     if (ret < 0) {
412:         WIFI_LOGE("%s : send failed, ret=%d\n", __func__, ret);
413:         *response_len = 0;
414:         return BK_ERR_TIMEOUT;
415:     }
416: 
417:     if (ret > 0 && ret <= response_buf_size) {
418:         *response_len = (uint16_t)ret;
419:         WIFI_LOGV("%s : received response, len=%d\n", __func__, *response_len);
420:         return BK_OK;
421:     } else {
422:         WIFI_LOGE("%s : invalid response len=%d\n", __func__, ret);
423:         *response_len = 0;
424:         return BK_ERR_PARAM;
425:     }
426: }

584: {
585:     netif_ip4_config_t sta_ip_config = {0};
586:     netif_ip4_config_t ap_ip_config = {0};
587:     bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
588: 
589:     // Get STA IP config from CP
590:     if (bk_wifi_sta_get_ip4_config_from_cp(&sta_ip_config) == BK_OK)
591:     {
592:         if (sta_ip_config.ip[0] != '\0' && os_strcmp(sta_ip_config.ip, "0.0.0.0") != 0)
593:         {
594:             // Reference the processing flow of EVENT_WIFI_STA_CONNECTED:
595:             // 1. Disable DHCP and set static IP
596:             // 2. Close STA interface
597:             // 3. Set IP configuration
598:             // 4. Start STA interface
599: #if CONFIG_NETIF_LWIP
600:             sta_ip_mode_set(0);
601:             sta_ip_down();
602: #endif

604:             ret = bk_netif_set_ip4_config(NETIF_IF_STA, &sta_ip_config);

606: #if CONFIG_NETIF_LWIP
607:                 sta_ip_start();
608: #endif

613:                 WDRV_LOGE("Failed to set STA IP config, ret=%d\r\n", ret);

616:     }
617: 
618:     // Get AP IP config from CP

621:         if (ap_ip_config.ip[0] != '\0' && os_strcmp(ap_ip_config.ip, "0.0.0.0") != 0)

623:             // Reference the processing flow similar to STA:

626:             // 3. Start AP interface
627: #if CONFIG_NETIF_LWIP
628:             if (uap_ip_is_start()) {
629:                 uap_ip_down();
630:             }
631: #endif
632: 
633:             ret = bk_netif_set_ip4_config(NETIF_IF_AP, &ap_ip_config);
634:             if (ret == BK_OK) {
635: #if CONFIG_NETIF_LWIP
636:                 uap_ip_start();
637: #endif
638:                 WDRV_LOGV("AP IP config synced from CP: %s/%s gw:%s dns:%s\r\n",
639:                         ap_ip_config.ip, ap_ip_config.mask,
640:                         ap_ip_config.gateway, ap_ip_config.dns);
641:             } else {
642:                 WDRV_LOGE("Failed to set AP IP config, ret=%d\r\n", ret);
643:             }
644:         }
645:     }
646: 
647:     return BK_OK;
648: }

846:         case WIFI_SECURITY_WPA_AES:

848:             break;
849:         case WIFI_SECURITY_WPA_MIXED:

851:             break;
852:         case WIFI_SECURITY_WPA2_TKIP:

854:             break;
855:         case WIFI_SECURITY_WPA2_AES:

857:             break;
858:         case WIFI_SECURITY_WPA2_MIXED:
859:             g_ap_param_ptr->cipher_suite = WIFI_SECURITY_WPA2_MIXED;
860:             break;
861: #if CONFIG_SOFTAP_WPA3
862:         case WIFI_SECURITY_WPA3_SAE:
863:             g_ap_param_ptr->cipher_suite = WIFI_SECURITY_WPA3_SAE;
864:             break;
865:         case WIFI_SECURITY_WPA3_WPA2_MIXED:
866:             g_ap_param_ptr->cipher_suite = WIFI_SECURITY_WPA3_WPA2_MIXED;
867:             break;
868: #endif
869:         default:
870:             g_ap_param_ptr->cipher_suite = WIFI_SECURITY_WPA2_AES;

874:         os_memcpy(g_ap_param_ptr->key, ap_config->password, g_ap_param_ptr->key_len);

879:         os_memcpy(g_ap_param_ptr->vsie, ap_config->vsie, g_ap_param_ptr->vsie_len);
880: #endif
881: 
882:     g_wlan_general_param->dhcp_enable = 1;
883:     g_ap_param_ptr->hidden_ssid = ap_config->hidden;
884: 
885:     return BK_OK;

1434: bk_err_t bk_wifi_sta_start(void)
1435: {
1436:     bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
1437:     bool start_new = true;
1438: 
1439:     WDRV_LOGD("sta starting\n");
1440: 
1441:     if (!wifi_sta_is_configured()) {
1442:         WDRV_LOGD("sta start fail, sta not configured\n");
1443:         return BK_ERR_WIFI_STA_NOT_CONFIG;
1444:     }
1445: 
1446:     wifi_lock();
1447: #if CONFIG_P2P
1448:     if (s_wifi_p2p_enabled) {
1449:         ret = BK_ERR_STATE;
1450:         start_new = false;
1451:     }
1452: #endif
1453:     if (start_new && (s_wifi_state_bits & WIFI_STA_STARTED_BIT)) {
1454:         start_new = false;
1455:     }
1456:     if (start_new) {
1457:         wifi_set_state_bit_locked(WIFI_STA_STARTED_BIT);
1458:     }
1459:     wifi_unlock();
1460: 
1461: #if CONFIG_P2P
1462:     if (ret == BK_ERR_STATE) {
1463:         WDRV_LOGD("sta start fail, p2p already enabled\n");
1464:         return ret;
1465:     }
1466: #endif
1467:     if (!start_new) {
1468:         WDRV_LOGD("sta already started, ignored!\n");
1469:         return BK_OK;
1470:     }
1471: 
1472:     wifi_sta_init_global_config();
1473: 
1474:     //bk_wifi_init();
1475: 
1476:     /* always connect the AP automatically */
1477:     bk_wifi_sta_connect();
1478: 
1479:     ret = wifi_send_com_api_cmd(STA_START, 0);
1480:     if (ret != BK_OK)
1481:     {
1482:         WDRV_LOGD("%s failed, ret=%d\n",__func__, ret);
1483:     }
1484: 
1485:     return BK_OK;
1486: }

308: {
309:     int ret = 0;
310:     uint32_t int_level = 0;
311:     wdrv_cmd_hdr *hdr = NULL;
312:     static uint16_t s_cmd_sn = 0;
313:     WDRV_LOGV("%s msg:%x len:%d\r\n",__func__, msg, msg_len);
314:     BK_ASSERT(msg_len < MAX_CMD_BUF_PAYLOAD);
315:     if (!msg) {
316:         WDRV_LOGE("%s: warning msg is null.\n", __func__);
317:         ret = -2;
318:         return ret;
319:     }
320:     hdr = (wdrv_cmd_hdr *)msg;
321:     WDRV_ENTER_TXMSG_CRITICAL(int_level);
322:     s_cmd_sn++;
323:     hdr->cmd_sn = s_cmd_sn;
324:     WDRV_EXIT_TXMSG_CRITICAL(int_level);
325:     WDRV_LOGD("%s: msg_id:0x%x len:%d sn:%d waitcfm:%d cfm_id:%x cfm_sn:%d \n", __func__, 
326:             hdr->cmd_id, msg_len, hdr->cmd_sn, cfm->waitcfm, cfm->cfm_id, cfm->cfm_sn);

328:     if (cfm->waitcfm == WDRV_CMD_WAITCFM) {
329: 
330:         ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&cfm->sema, 1);

336:             cfm->cfm_sn  = hdr->cmd_sn;
337: 
338:             WDRV_ENTER_TXMSG_CRITICAL(int_level);
339:             co_list_push_back((struct co_list *)&wdrv_host_env.cfm_pending_list,(struct co_list_hdr *)&cfm->list);
340:             WDRV_EXIT_TXMSG_CRITICAL(int_level);
341: 
342:             wdrv_tx_msg_send(msg, msg_len, WDRV_CMD_WAITCFM);
343: 
344:             // The len of result-buff is PRIVATE_COMMAND_DEF_LEN.
345:             if ((rtos_get_semaphore(&cfm->sema, WDRV_CMDCFM_TIMEOUT)) != 0) {
346: 
347:                 rtos_lock_mutex(&wdrv_host_env.cfm_lock);
348:                 WDRV_ENTER_TXMSG_CRITICAL(int_level);
349:                 co_list_extract((struct co_list *)&wdrv_host_env.cfm_pending_list,(struct co_list_hdr *)&cfm->list);
350:                 WDRV_EXIT_TXMSG_CRITICAL(int_level);
351:                 rtos_unlock_mutex(&wdrv_host_env.cfm_lock);
352: 
353:                 //Print AP/CP debug statistics
354:                 wdrv_print_debug_info();
355:                 wdrv_cntrl_get_cif_stats();
356: 
357:                 WDRV_LOGW("%s: cmd confirm timeout.\n", __func__);
358:                 ret = -3;
359:             } else {
360:                 // receive cmd-cfm result
361:                 ret = cfm->cfm_len;
362:             }
363: 
364:             rtos_deinit_semaphore(&cfm->sema);
365:         }
366:         else
367:         {
368:             BK_LOGD(NULL, "%s,%d,sema_init fail,send msg fail\n",__func__,__LINE__);
369:         }
370:     } else if (cfm->waitcfm == WDRV_CMD_NOWAITCFM) {
371:         // cmd send direct.
372:         wdrv_tx_msg_send(msg, msg_len, WDRV_CMD_NOWAITCFM);
373:     } else {
374:         WDRV_LOGE("waitcfm param err\n");
375:         ret = -1;
376:     }
377: 
378:     return ret;

152: uint8_t wdrv_recv_buffer(void *param, uint32_t *payload)
153: {
154:     uint8_t num_temp = 0;
155:     uint8_t ret = BK_OK;
156:     cpdu_t* temp_next = NULL;
157:     ipc_chnl_node_t *node = (ipc_chnl_node_t*)payload;
158:     uint8_t chan_id = node->channel;
159:     cpdu_t* head = PTR_FROM_U32(cpdu_t,node->head);
160:     cpdu_t* tail = PTR_FROM_U32(cpdu_t,node->tail);
161:     uint8_t num = node->num;
162: 
163:     while(head)
164:     {
165:         struct cpdu_t * hdr = PTR_FROM_U32(struct cpdu_t,head);
166:         temp_next = hdr->next;
167:         WDRV_LOGV("%s,chan_id=%d,head=0x%x,tail=0x%x,num=%d,start!\n",__func__,chan_id,head,tail,num);
168:         //stack_mem_dump((uint32_t)head,(uint32_t)head+300);
169: 
170:         //__asm_flush_dcache_range(PTR_FROM_U32(void,head)-100,PTR_FROM_U32(void,head)+2048);
171: 
172:         switch(chan_id)
173:         {
174:             case RX_BK_CMD_DATA:
175:             {
176:                 wdrv_msg_sender((uint32_t)(head + 1),WDRV_TASK_MSG_EVENT,0);
177:                 break;
178:             }
179:             case RX_MSDU_DATA:
180:             {
181:                 #if CONFIG_BK_RAW_LINK
182:                 if (head->co_hdr.special_type == TX_RLK_FREE_MEM_TYPE) 
183:                 {
184:                     ret = wdrv_msg_sender((uint32_t)(head + 1),WDRV_TASK_MSG_EVENT,0);
185:                 }
186:                 else
187:                 #endif
188:                 {
189:                     struct pbuf * p = NULL;
190:                     p = (struct pbuf*)((struct pbuf*)head - 1);
191:                     ret = wdrv_msg_sender((uint32_t)p,WDRV_TASK_MSG_RXDATA,0);
192:                 }
193:                 //bk_mem_dump("wdrv_recv p",PTR_TO_U32(p),sizeof(struct pbuf)+8);
194:                 if(ret != BK_OK)
195:                 {
196:                     BK_ASSERT(0);
197:                 }
198:                 break;
199:             }
200:             default:
201:                 WDRV_LOGE("%s,chan_id=%d,error data type\n",__func__,chan_id);
202:         };
203:         num_temp++;
204:         head = temp_next;
205:         if((num_temp == num)||(head == 0)) break;
206:     }
207:     return ret;
208: }

25: 
26: #define CHNL_STATE_BUSY		1
27: #define CHNL_STATE_IDLE		0
28: 
29: /* If a physical channel stays BUSY longer than this (in milliseconds)
30:  * without seeing the matching ACK from the peer CPU, mb_chnl_write() will
31:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
32:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
33:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */
34: #define MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS		200
35: 
36: typedef struct
37: {
38: 	volatile u8		tx_state;	/* physical channel tx state. */
39: 	u8		tx_seq;				/* physical channel tx sequence. */
40: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */
41: 	u8		tx_hdr_cmd;
42: 	u32		rx_fault_cnt;
43: 	u32		tx_fault_cnt;
44: 	/* Wall-clock (ms via rtos_get_time()) at which tx_state was set to
45: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
46: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
47: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
48: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;
49: } mb_phy_chnl_cb_t;
50: 
51: 
52: #define CHNL_CTRL_MASK			0xF
53: /*
54:  *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
55:  *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
56:  *  use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
57:  *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
58:  */
59: #define CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX		0x01
60: 
61: #define CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX		0x02
62: #define CHNL_CTRL_RESET			0x04
63: 
64: typedef union
65: {
66: 	struct
67: 	{
68: 		u32		cmd            : 8;
69: 		u32		state          : 4;
70: 		u32		ctrl           : 4;
71: 		u32		tx_seq         : 8;
72: 		u32		logical_chnl   : 8;
73: 	} ;
74: 	u32		data;
75: } phy_chnnl_hdr_t;
76: 
77: typedef struct
78: {
79: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t	hdr;
80: 
81: 	u32		param1;
82: 	u32		param2;
83: 	u32		param3;
84: } mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t;
85: 
86: typedef struct
87: {
88: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t	hdr;
89: 
90: 	u32		data1;
91: 	u32		data2;
92: 	u32		data3;
93: } mb_phy_chnl_ack_t;
94: 
95: typedef union
96: {
97: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t		phy_ch_hdr;
98: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	phy_ch_cmd;
99: 	mb_phy_chnl_ack_t	phy_ch_ack;
100: 	mailbox_data_t		mb_data;
101: } mb_phy_chnl_union_t;
102: 
103: typedef struct
104: {
105: 	volatile u8		tx_state;				/* logical channel tx state. */
106: 	u8				in_used;
107: 	chnl_rx_isr_t		rx_isr;
108: 	chnl_tx_isr_t		tx_isr;
109: 	chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t	tx_cmpl_isr;
110: 	void *				isr_param;
111: 	mailbox_data_t		chnnl_tx_buff;		/* logical channel tx buffer. */
112: } mb_log_chnl_cb_t;
113: 
114: #define PHY_CHNL_NUM		SYSTEM_CPU_NUM
115: 
116: static mb_phy_chnl_cb_t		phy_chnl_x_cb[PHY_CHNL_NUM];
117: static mb_log_chnl_cb_t		log_chnl_cb0[CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_START];
118: static mb_log_chnl_cb_t		log_chnl_cb1[CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_START];
119: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 2
120: static mb_log_chnl_cb_t		log_chnl_cb2[CP2_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP2_MB_LOG_CHNL_START];
121: #endif
122: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 3
123: static mb_log_chnl_cb_t		log_chnl_cb3[CP3_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP3_MB_LOG_CHNL_START];
124: #endif
125: 
126: static const u8 	phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[PHY_CHNL_NUM] = { 
127: 	ARRAY_SIZE(log_chnl_cb0),
128: 	ARRAY_SIZE(log_chnl_cb1),
129: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 2
130: 	ARRAY_SIZE(log_chnl_cb2),
131: #endif
132: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 3
133: 	ARRAY_SIZE(log_chnl_cb3),
134: #endif
135: //	CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_START, 
136: 	};
137: 
138: static const mb_log_chnl_cb_t *	phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[PHY_CHNL_NUM] = {
139: 	&log_chnl_cb0[0], 
140: 	&log_chnl_cb1[0], 
141: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 2
142: 	&log_chnl_cb2[0], 
143: #endif
144: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 3
145: 	&log_chnl_cb3[0], 
146: #endif
147: 	};
148: 
149: static u8				mb_chnnl_init_ok = 0;
150: 
151: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
152: #include "spinlock.h"
153: static SPINLOCK_SECTION volatile spinlock_t mb_chnl_spin_lock = SPIN_LOCK_INIT;
154: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
155: static inline uint32_t mb_chnl_enter_critical()
156: {
157: 	uint32_t flags = rtos_disable_int();
158: 
159: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
160: 	spin_lock(&mb_chnl_spin_lock);
161: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
162: 
163: 	return flags;
164: }
165: 
166: static inline void mb_chnl_exit_critical(uint32_t flags)
167: {
168: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
169: 	spin_unlock(&mb_chnl_spin_lock);
170: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
171: 
172: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
173: }
174: 
175: /* =====================      physical channel functions      ==================*/
176: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_cnt = 0;
177: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_cnt = 0;
178: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt = 0;
179: 
180: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt = 0;
181: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt = 0;
182: 
183: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
184: {
185: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
186: 	
187: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
188: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
189: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
190: 	
191: 	return ret_code;
192: }
193: 
194: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
195: {
196: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
197: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
198: 	u16 			chnl_type;
199: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
200: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
201: 
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
203: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
204: 
205: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
206: 		return 4;
207: 
208: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
209: 		return 5;
210: 
211: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
212: 		return 3;
213: 
214: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
215: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
216: 
217: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
218: 		return 1;
219: 
220: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
221: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
222: 
223: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
224: 
225: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
226: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
227: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
228: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
229: 
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
231: 
232: 	__DMB();
233: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
234: 
235: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
236: 
237: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
238: 
239: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
240: 	{
241: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
242: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
243: 
244: 		return 2;
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
248: 
249: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
250: 
251: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
252: 	{
253: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	return 0;
257: }
258: 
259: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
260: {
261: 	u8		log_chnl;
262: 	u8		ret_code;
263: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
264: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
265: 
266: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
267: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
268: 
269: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
270: 
271: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
272: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
273: 
274: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
275: 
276: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
277: 		return;
278: 
279: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
280: 		return;
281: 
282: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
283: 		return;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
286: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
287: 
288: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
289: 		return;
290: 
291: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
292: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
293: 	{
294: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
295: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
296: 
297: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
298: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
299: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
300: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
301: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
302: 		{
303: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
304: 			u8  i;
305: 
306: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
308: 
309: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
310: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
311: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
312: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
313: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
314: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
315: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
316: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
317: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
318: 					}
319: 					break;
320: 				}
321: 			}
322: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
323: 		}
324: 		return;
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
328: 	{
329: 		/* clear following header members. */
330: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
331: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
332: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
333: 
334: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
335: 
336: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
337: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
338: 	}
339: 
340: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
341: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
342: 	{
343: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
344: 			break;
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
348: 	{
349: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
350: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
351: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
352: 		return;
353: 	}
354: 
355: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
356: 
357: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
358: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
359: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
361: 
362: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
363: 
364: 	if(ret_code != 0)
365: 	{
366: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
368: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
369: 	}
370: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
371: 
372: 	return;
373: 
374: }

376: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
377: {
378: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
379: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
380: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
381: 	u16 		chnl_type;
382: 
383: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
384: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
385: 
386: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
387: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
392: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
393: 
394: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
395: 		return;
396: 
397: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
398: 		return;
399: 
400: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
401: 		return;
402: 
403: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
404: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
405: 
406: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
407: 
408: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
409: 	{
410: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
411: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
412: 
413: 		return;
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
417: 	{
418: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
419: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
420: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
421: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
422: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
423: 
424: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
425: 
426: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
427: 	}
428: 	else
429: 	{
430: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
434: 	{
435: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
436: 		return;
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
440: 
441: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
442: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
443: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
444: 
445: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
446: 
447: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
448: 
449: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
450: 
451: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
452: 	{
453: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
454: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
455: 
456: 		return;
457: 	}
458: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
459: 	return;
460: }

462: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
463: {
464: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
465: 
466: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
467: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
468: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
469: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
470: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
471: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
472: 
473: 	/*
474: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
475: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
476: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
477: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
478: 	 */
479: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
480: 	{
481: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
482: 	}
483: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
484: 	{
485: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
486: 	}
487: }

489: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
490: {
491: 	u8		ret_code;
492: 
493: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
494: 
495: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
496: 
497: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
498: 
499: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
500: 		return;
501: 
502: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
503: 		return;
504: 
505: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
506: 
507: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
508: 	{
509: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
510: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
511: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
512: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
513: 
514: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
515: 
516: 		if(ret_code != 0)
517: 		{
518: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
519: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
520: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
521: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
522: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
523: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
524: 
525: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
526: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
527: 			}
528: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
529: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
530: 		}
531: 	}
532: 
533: 	return;
534: }

536: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
537: 
538: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
539: {
540: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
541: 	u16 			chnl_type;
542: 
543: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
544: 
545: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
546: 
547: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
548: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
549: 
550: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
551: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
552: 
553: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
554: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
555: 
556: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
557: 
558: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
559: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
560: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
561: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
562: 
563: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
564: 
565: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
566: 
567: 	/*
568: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
569: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
570: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
571: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
572: 	 */
573: 	while(1)
574: 	{
575: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
576: 
577: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
578: 		{
579: 			break;
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 
583: 	return ret_code;
584: }

586: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_reset(u8 dst_cpu)
587: {
588: 	u16 				chnl_type;
589: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	cmd_buf = {0};
590: 
591: 	if(SELF_CPU == dst_cpu)
592: 	{
593: 		return BK_OK;
594: 	}
595: 
596: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
597: 
598: 	cmd_buf.hdr.data = 0;
599: 	cmd_buf.hdr.ctrl |= (CHNL_CTRL_RESET | CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX);
600: 	cmd_buf.hdr.logical_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU);
601: 
602: 	bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)&cmd_buf, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
603: 
604: 	return BK_OK;
605: }

607: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
608: /*
609:   * init logical chnanel module.
610:   * return:
611:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
612:   *     failed  : fail code.
613:   *
614:   */
615: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
616: {
617: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
618: 	int				i, j;
619: 
620: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
621: 
622: 	/*
623: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
624: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
625: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
626: 	 * can race here:
627: 	 *
628: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
629: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
630: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
631: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
632: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
633: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
634: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
635: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
636: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
637: 	 *
638: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
639: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
640: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
641: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
642: 	 */
643: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
644: 	{
645: 		return BK_OK;
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
649: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
650: 	{
651: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
652: 		return BK_OK;
653: 	}
654: 
655: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
656: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
657: 	{
658: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
659: 
660: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
661: 
662: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
663: 
664: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
665: 		{
666: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
671: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
672: 	{
673: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
674: 		return ret_code;
675: 	}
676: 
677: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
678: 
679: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
680: 	{
681: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
682: 
683: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
684: 	}
685: 
686: 	mb_phy_chnl_reset(0);
687: 
688: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
689: 
690: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
691: 
692: 	return BK_OK;
693: }

695: /*
696:   * open logical chnanel.
697:   * input:
698:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to open.

702:   *     failed  : fail code.

705: bk_err_t mb_chnl_open(u8 log_chnl, void * callback_param)
706: {

708: 	{
709: 		bk_err_t		ret_code;
710: 
711: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_init();
712: 
713: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
714: 		{
715: 			return ret_code;
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: 
719: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
720: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
721: 
722: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
723: 
724: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
725: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
726: 
727: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
728: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
729: 
730: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
731: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
732: 
733: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);

735: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])

742: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param = callback_param;

744: 	return BK_OK;

216:  *       to become availale since the stack doesn't retry to send a packet
217:  *       dropped because of memory failure (except for the TCP timers).

21: # BK7258 OpenVela AP Wi-Fi 移植实施与验证方案
22: 
23: > 文档状态：基于当前 OpenVela AP、原厂 AVDK AP/CP Wi-Fi 和 Mailbox 源码交叉验证后的实施基线。本文固定采用 W1：不修改 CPU0/CP 固件，OpenVela AP 兼容原厂 `controller_if` 协议。本文不把新建 CP bridge、socket proxy 或重新设计 descriptor ring 作为本轮交付方案。
24: 
25: ## 1. 目标和固定结论
26: 
27: ### 1.1 移植目标
28: 
29: 在物理 CPU1 单核运行的 OpenVela AP 上实现 Wi-Fi STA 基础能力，同时保持以下内容原样：
30: 
31: - CPU0/CP 固件及其 FreeRTOS 运行环境。
32: - CP 侧 Wi-Fi RWNX、UMAC/LMAC、MAC/PHY、RF、校准和共存逻辑。
33: - CP 侧 `controller_if`、`cif_ipc` 和原厂 Mailbox logical-channel wire ABI。
34: - bootloader、分区、CP 启动 AP 和 AP heartbeat/PWC 契约。
35: 
36: OpenVela AP 新增：
37: 
38: - 与原厂 `MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD`、`MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA` 兼容的 logical channel。
39: - 原厂 Wi-Fi command/event 协议兼容层。
40: - AP/CP 共享 Wi-Fi buffer 的地址校验、生命周期和 cache 处理。
41: - NuttX `netdev_lowerhalf` Wi-Fi 网卡 `wlan0`。
42: - NuttX wireless handlers，用于配置 SSID、密码、国家码、扫描、连接和断开。
43: - Wi-Fi transport、控制面和数据面的统计、超时与复位恢复。
44: 
45: ### 1.2 固定架构
46: 
47: ```text
48: CPU1/OpenVela AP，单核
49:   ├─ OpenVela application/socket
50:   ├─ NuttX IPv4/IPv6/TCP/UDP/DHCP/DNS
51:   ├─ BK7258 wlan0 netdev lower-half
52:   ├─ Wi-Fi control proxy
53:   └─ Wi-Fi IPC transport
54:           │
55:           │ AP→CP CMD/DATA 0x14/0x15
56:           │ CP→AP CMD/DATA 0x44/0x45
57:           │ MBOX0 + 共享 SRAM pointer/list
58:           ▼
59: CPU0/Armino CP，保持原样
60:   ├─ controller_if/cif
61:   ├─ Wi-Fi command/event handler
62:   ├─ RWNX/FHOST/UMAC/LMAC
63:   ├─ WPA/关联控制
64:   └─ Wi-Fi MAC/PHY/RF
65: ```
66: 
67: 本方案中：
68: 
69: - CPU0 是 CP，不是 OpenVela AP。
70: - CPU1 是当前 OpenVela AP primary，也是唯一启用的 AP CPU。
71: - CPU2 保持当前单核 bring-up 状态，不参与 Wi-Fi ISR、worker 或共享 buffer 管理。
72: - CP 是 Wi-Fi radio/controller 的唯一所有者。
73: - NuttX 是 AP 网络协议栈的所有者。
74: - 第一版采用 copy 接入 NuttX `netpkt_t`，不追求 NuttX packet 与 CP pbuf 零拷贝。
75: 
76: ### 1.3 本轮明确不采用的方案
77: 
78: - 不修改 CP，增加新的 Ethernet bridge 或新 ring 协议。
79: - 不把 CP Wi-Fi/RWNX 静态库链接进 OpenVela AP。
80: - 不让 OpenVela AP直接访问 Wi-Fi MAC/PHY/RF 寄存器。
81: - 不在 AP 内同时运行 Armino lwIP 和 NuttX 网络栈。
82: - 不通过 socket RPC 把全部 socket 操作代理到 CP。
83: - 不改变原厂 `MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD`、`MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA` 编号和 command ID。
84: - 不在第一阶段启用 SoftAP、P2P、monitor、raw link、CSI、FTM 或零拷贝。
85: - 不在第一阶段启用 CPU2 SMP。
86: 
87: ## 2. 原厂部署和代码依据
88: 
89: ### 2.1 CP 运行真实 Wi-Fi controller
90: 
91: CP 配置启用 Wi-Fi 和 virtual network controller：
92:

94: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/bk7258.defconfig:286`
95: 
96: CP Wi-Fi 初始化在完成 RWNX/FHOST、RX buffer 和 WPA 线程后初始化 controller interface：
97: 
98: ```text
99: wifi_init()
100:   -> fhost_rxbuf_push()
101:   -> wpas_thread_start()
102:   -> cif_init()
103: ```
104: 
105: 代码：
106: 
107: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_init.c:119-130`
108: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.c:319-364`
109: 
110: `cif_init()` 完成：
111: 
112: - `cif_ipc_init()`。
113: - command/event buffer 初始化。
114: - CP 本地 queue 和 `cif_thread` 创建。
115: - host/low-voltage 状态初始化。
116: 
117: ### 2.2 原厂 AP 是 Wi-Fi virtual front-end
118: 
119: 原 AVDK AP 关闭本地 Wi-Fi controller，但启用 virtual controller：
120: 
121: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:240-243`

128:   -> wdrv_init()
129:       -> wdrv_ipc_init()
130:       -> wdrv command/event buffer init
131:       -> wdrv_thread
132:       -> wdrv_host_init()

137: 
138: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:236-269`

144: 需要特别说明，当前 `app_ab` CP 最终配置中 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER=y`，但 `CONFIG_WIFI_CP_IPC` 未启用：

156: ### 2.3 Wi-Fi logical channel
157: 
158: CPU1/AP 到 CPU0/CP：
159: 
160: ```text
161: MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD  = 0x14
162: MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA = 0x15
163: ```
164: 
165: CPU0/CP 到 CPU1/AP：
166: 
167: ```text
168: MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD  = 0x44
169: MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA = 0x45

172: 原厂定义：
173: 
174: - AP：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:77-96`

179: AP 侧映射：
180: 
181: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_ipc.h:17-18`
182: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_ipc.c:29-45`

195: 
196: Mailbox logical payload 是 16 字节 `ipc_chnl_node_t`：
197: 
198: ```c
199: typedef struct
200: {
201:     uint32_t ipc_hdr;
202:     uint32_t head;
203:     uint32_t tail;
204:     uint8_t channel;
205:     uint8_t num;
206:     uint16_t rsve;
207: } ipc_chnl_node_t;
208: ```
209: 
210: 依据：
211: 
212: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_ipc.h:38-47`
213: 
214: 数据对象使用 `cpdu_t`：
215: 
216: ```c

218: {
219:     uint16_t length;
220:     uint8_t type:4;
221:     uint8_t dst_index:4;
222:     uint8_t need_free:1;
223:     uint8_t is_buf_bank:1;
224:     uint8_t vif_idx:2;
225:     uint8_t special_type:3;
226:     uint8_t rsve:1;
227: };
228: 
229: typedef struct cpdu_t
230: {
231:     struct cpdu_t *next;
232:     struct common_header co_hdr;
233: } cpdu_t;
234: ```
235: 
236: 依据：
237: 
238: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h:242-289`
239: 
240: AP→CP TX 通过 `head/tail/num` 传递 command 或 MSDU 链：
241: 
242: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_tx.c:113-180`

245: 
246: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.c:149-220`

248: 原 AP 接收后直接按照 Beken `pbuf + cpdu_t` 布局解引用：
249: 
250: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_rx.c:152-207`

252: 这是 W1 最大兼容约束。OpenVela 不得假设 CP 能理解 NuttX `netpkt_t` 或 `iob_s`。

254: ### 2.5 Wi-Fi command/confirmation
255: 
256: 原 AP command 结构带 `cmd_id` 和 `cmd_sn`，等待 confirmation 时按：

268: CP 公开的 Wi-Fi API command ID 包括：

430: - 无 handler 的合法通道返回 `CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL`。
431: - TX completion 只在匹配 ACK 后调用。
432: - timeout/reset 对 active transaction 回报失败，不能静默清 busy。

434: ### 4.3 Wi-Fi command transport
435: 
436: AP command 路径：
437: 
438: ```text
439: wireless_ops/ioctl
440:   -> bk7258_wifi_control_request()
441:   -> 分配 command buffer
442:   -> 填写 cmd_id/cmd_sn/payload
443:   -> cpdu_t header
444:   -> ipc_chnl_node_t(head=tail, num=1, channel=TX_BK_CMD_DATA)
445:   -> MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD 0x14
446:   -> transport ACK
447:   -> CP command confirmation 0x44
448:   -> 按 cmd_id + sequence 唤醒等待者
449: ```
450: 
451: 必须区分：
452: 
453: - transport ACK：CP 已接管 `ipc_chnl_node_t`。
454: - command confirmation：CP 已执行业务命令并返回结果。
455: 
456: 控制请求使用 NuttX mutex + semaphore，要求：
457: 
458: - 每个请求有有界 timeout。
459: - timeout 后从 pending list 删除。
460: - CP/AP reset 时全部 pending request 返回 `-ECONNRESET`。
461: - 迟到 confirmation 只计数，不访问已释放 request。
462: - 不能在 Mailbox ISR 中阻塞。
463: 
464: ### 4.4 Wi-Fi TX 数据面
465: 
466: 由于 CP 不修改，CP 仍要求 Beken `pbuf/cpdu_t` 兼容布局。第一版在 AP 定义最小 wire-compatible TX allocation，不把 lwIP 协议栈带入 NuttX：
467: 
468: ```text
469: [wire pbuf-compatible metadata][cpdu_t][Ethernet frame]
470: ```
471: 
472: 是否必须完整复制原厂 `struct pbuf`，必须通过 CP `cif_handle_txdata()` 和实际编译配置确认。不能凭 `cpdu_t` 单独推断。正式编码前要固定：
473: 
474: - `sizeof(struct pbuf)`。
475: - payload 指针相对 pbuf/cpdu 的布局。
476: - `CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY` 最终值。
477: - CP 是否修改 pbuf refcount、flags、next 和 payload。
478: - TX completion 是通过反向 `need_free` packet 还是 command confirmation。
479: 
480: 当前 `app_ab` direct-push 基线已经显示，CP 的 `cif_handle_txdata()` 会用 `head - sizeof(struct pbuf)` 还原并直接访问 AP 创建的 `struct pbuf`；TX 完成时 `cif_free_ap_txbuf()` 把同一对象的 `need_free` 置 1，再通过 CP→AP `WIFI_DATA 0x45` 返回。因此 W3 不是只兼容一个抽象的“pbuf-like metadata”，而是必须冻结并复现该最终构建所使用的完整 lwIP `struct pbuf` ABI，包括字段大小、顺序、对齐、payload 指针、refcount 和 `pbuf + 1 == cpdu` 布局。若无法证明 NuttX AP RAM 地址可被 CP 直接访问，或者无法安全复现该 ABI，则“不修改 CP”的 W1 数据面方案被阻断；不得继续靠猜测实现。
481: 
482: 依据：
483: 
484: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:138-179`
485: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_mem_mgmt.c:8-24`
486: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_tx.c:49-111`
487: 
488: TX 路径：
489: 
490: ```text
491: NuttX transmit(netpkt)
492:   -> 从 AP Wi-Fi TX pool 取对象
493:   -> netpkt_copyout() 到兼容 Ethernet payload
494:   -> 设置 cpdu.length/type/vif/need_free
495:   -> 保存 netpkt 和 shared object 的 pending 关系
496:   -> MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA
497:   -> CP 接管并发往 Wi-Fi
498:   -> CP 返回 TX completion/free indication
499:   -> 释放 shared object 和 netpkt
500:   -> netdev_lower_txdone()
501: ```
502: 
503: `transmit()` 必须遵守：
504: 
505: - `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/net/netdev_lowerhalf.h:159-169`
506: 
507: 返回 `OK` 后 driver 已接管 `netpkt`，必须在完成路径释放；返回负 errno 时由 upper half 回收。
508: 
509: 第一版必须 copy，不能把 NuttX heap pointer 或 `netpkt_t *` 直接发送给 CP。
510: 
511: ### 4.5 Wi-Fi RX 数据面
512: 
513: CP→AP `ipc_chnl_node_t` 到达后：
514: 
515: 1. Mailbox ISR 复制 CP→AP `WIFI_DATA 0x45` 的 16-byte node，只做不需要解引用远端 pointer 的 `channel/num` 基础检查并投递 RX worker。
516: 2. RX worker 校验 `head/tail` 地址窗口和对齐。
517: 3. RX worker 按 `num` 遍历 CP 链，每一步校验 pointer、最小 header、length、next 和是否循环。
518: 4. RX worker为合法 frame分配 `NETPKT_RX` 并复制 Ethernet frame。
519: 5. 无论复制成功、队列满还是帧被拒绝，都必须按冻结后的所有权协议决定回收、暂缓或触发 channel reset；不能既丢 descriptor 又不归还 CP buffer。
520: 6. 按原厂协议向 CP 返回 free/recycle indication；该方向使用 AP→CP `WIFI_DATA 0x15`，具体 `need_free`/buffer-bank 状态必须在 W0 trace 中冻结。
521: 7. 调用 `netdev_lower_rxready()`；`receive()` 返回准备好的 packet。
522: 
523: 禁止在 Mailbox ISR 中：
524: 
525: - 调用完整 NuttX IP input。
526: - 动态执行复杂 command handler。
527: - 等待 semaphore。
528: - 递归发送大量 free message。
529: - 直接释放 CP heap pointer。
530: 
531: 原 AP 的 RX 逻辑参考：
532: 
533: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_rx.c:72-149`
534: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_rx.c:152-207`
535: 
536: ### 4.6 跨核 pointer 校验
537: 
538: W1 必须接受原厂 CP 指针协议，但每次解引用前都要校验。至少包括：
539: 
540: - pointer 4-byte 对齐。
541: - pointer 位于允许的 CP RAM/PSRAM shared window。
542: - `length` 不小于 header，不超过协商的最大 frame。
543: - `num` 不超过固定上限。
544: - `next` 每次都位于允许窗口。
545: - 链表实际节点数不超过 `num`。
546: - 最后节点和 `tail` 一致。
547: - 地址加长度无 32-bit overflow。
548: - 同一地址不能在当前 ownership table 中重复出现。
549: - reset epoch 后不接受旧 transaction 中的 pointer。
550: 
551: 当前 `CP_RAM_START/END` 硬编码只能作为 bring-up 值：
552: 
553: - `contest/.../bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:33-34`
554: 
555: 正式实现应由目标分区生成结果导出 shared window，不能在 Wi-Fi driver 再复制一组常量。
556: 
557: ### 4.7 Cache 和内存属性
558: 
559: 首版要求 Wi-Fi shared pool 位于双方都可访问的 non-cacheable、shareable 区域。若无法做到，所有权交接必须按以下顺序：
560: 
561: 发送端：
562: 
563: ```text
564: 写 payload
565: 写 descriptor/header
566: clean payload cache
567: clean descriptor cache
568: DMB
569: 发送 mailbox doorbell
570: ```
571: 
572: 接收端：
573: 
574: ```text
575: 收到 mailbox
576: invalidate descriptor cache
577: 读取并校验 descriptor
578: invalidate payload cache
579: 读取 payload
580: 处理完成后 clean ownership/completion
581: DMB
582: 发送 ACK/free indication
583: ```
584: 
585: `volatile` 和 `dmb sy` 不能替代 cache maintenance。
586: 
587: ### 4.8 Reset 和恢复
588: 
589: 不修改 CP 意味着不能给 CP wire descriptor增加新 epoch 字段，因此 AP 必须在本地维护 transport generation，并使用原厂 logical channel reset 行为完成重同步：
590: 
591: ```text
592: 检测 CP reset/channel reset/heartbeat failure
593:   -> carrier off
594:   -> 阻止新 TX
595:   -> 所有 control request 返回 -ECONNRESET
596:   -> 回收 AP 自有 TX packet
597:   -> 丢弃尚未交给 NuttX 的 CP RX descriptor
598:   -> 清理 channel active/pending/ACK queue
599:   -> 重新 open WIFI_CMD/WIFI_DATA
600:   -> 重新获取 MAC/status
601:   -> 恢复 STA config
602:   -> 重新连接
603:   -> 收到 connected event 后 carrier on
604: ```
605: 
606: 由于 CP 协议本身没有 generation，旧 CP pointer 的安全回收能力有限。这是 W1 在“不修改 CP”约束下的固有风险，必须通过 reset 时 FIFO drain、channel reset 和 ownership table 清空降低风险。
607:

618:                                 netpkt_t *pkt);

620: static void bk7258_wlan_reclaim(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *dev);

635: ### 5.2 carrier 语义
636: 
637: `ifup()` 只表示 driver 启动成功，不表示 STA 已关联。正确语义：
638: 
639: ```text
640: ifup
641:   -> transport ready
642:   -> STA_START/启用控制面
643:   -> 保持 carrier off
644: 
645: CP STA_CONNECTED event
646:   -> netdev_lower_carrier_on()
647: 
648: CP STA_DISCONNECTED event
649:   -> netdev_lower_carrier_off()
650: ```
651: 
652: 不要照搬 BK7236N 在 `ifup()` 后立即 carrier-on 的行为。
653: 
654: ### 5.3 wireless handlers
655: 
656: 启用 `CONFIG_NETDEV_WIRELESS_HANDLER` 后实现：
657: 
658: - `connect`
659: - `disconnect`
660: - `essid`
661: - `passwd`
662: - `auth`
663: - `country`
664: - `scan`
665: - 必要的 `range`
666: 
667: 接口：
668: 
669: - `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/net/netdev_lowerhalf.h:194-231`
670: 
671: 第一版可以将 BSSID、bitrate、txpower 等不支持项留空或返回 `-ENOTSUP`，不能伪造成功。
672: 
673: ### 5.4 网络栈所有权
674: 
675: 正式目标是 NuttX 作为 AP IP 栈。必须核对 CP `cif_wifi_dp` 对 ARP、IPv4、IPv6 和广播包的过滤逻辑，确保 AP 获得完整 Ethernet 流量。若 CP 仍消费 DHCP/ARP 或只转发特定业务包，`wlan0` 无法成为透明接口。
676: 
677: 在不修改 CP 的前提下，应优先使用原 AVDK AP 对应配置下已经启用的“AP host owns network”模式。必须从 CP 最终 `sdkconfig.h` 固定并记录：
678: 
679: - `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER`
680: - `CONFIG_WIFI_CP_IPC` 的最终值，并记录它在当前源码中不负责守卫 `cif_init()`。
681: - `CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY`
682: - RX direct-push/filter 相关配置
683: - CP lwIP 是否保留本地 IP
684: 
685: 当前 `app_ab` 生成配置已经确认：
686: 
687: ```text
688: CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER=y
689: CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY=n
690: CONFIG_CONTROLLER_RX_DIRECT_PSH=y
691: ```
692: 
693: 依据：
694: 
695: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/config/sdkconfig.h:124-129`
696: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/config/sdkconfig.cmake:256`
697: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/config/sdkconfig.h:153-154`
698: 
699: 这意味着当前基线优先走原厂 direct-push/共享 pbuf 所有权路径，而不是 CP copy adapter。OpenVela W1 必须兼容该路径，不能假定 CP 会在收到 NuttX frame 后自动复制到自己的 pbuf。
700: 
701: 如果原 CP 配置不能向 AP 提供完整 Ethernet frame，本轮“不修改 CP”的目标将被阻断，不能通过 AP 侧猜测绕过。

764: - AP TX 对象满足 `pbuf + 1 == cpdu`、payload/refcount/next 字段语义的双工具链 ABI 验证。
765: - 最终 CP `sdkconfig.h` 中 buffer-copy 和 VNET 配置。
766: - command、confirmation 和 event header 格式。
767: - TX completion、RX release 和 `need_free` 的状态图。

859: ### 8.1 Transport 门禁
860: 
861: - Wi-Fi CMD/DATA 双向各 10,000 次。

865: - timeout 后 channel 不永久 busy。
866: - AP/CP reset 后可以重新 open。

900: ## 9. 故障定位顺序
901: 
902: ### Wi-Fi command无响应
903: 
904: 1. 确认 CP 最终配置启用 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER`。
905: 2. 确认 AP TX `0x14` 已 open，CP→AP `0x44` 未被 AP RX 白名单拒绝。
906: 3. 检查 transport ACK channel/sequence。
907: 4. 检查 command `cmd_id/cmd_sn`。
908: 5. 检查 CP pointer窗口和 command buffer布局。
909: 6. 检查 confirmation ID 和 sequence。
910: 
911: ### 已关联但无 DHCP
912: 
913: 1. 确认 carrier 只在 connected event 后打开。
914: 2. 确认 AP 收到广播、ARP 和 DHCP frame。
915: 3. 检查 CP filter 是否仍把流量留给 CP lwIP。
916: 4. 检查 Ethernet header 是否完整。
917: 5. 检查 RX release是否过早。
918: 6. 检查 NuttX netdev link type。
919: 
920: ### TX 卡死
921: 
922: 1. 检查 logical TX-complete是否到达。
923: 2. 区分 transport ACK 和 Wi-Fi TX completion。
924: 3. 检查 `sending_flag` 或 NuttX pending table。
925: 4. 检查 CP 是否等待错误的 pbuf/cpdu布局。
926: 5. 检查 buffer ownership和 `need_free`。
927: 6. 检查 FIFO full后 ACK queue是否丢失。
928: 
929: ### 随机数据损坏
930: 
931: 1. 检查 pointer窗口。
932: 2. 检查 `sizeof/offsetof/packing`。
933: 3. 检查 cache clean/invalidate。
934: 4. 检查 AP 是否在 CP 完成前复用 TX buffer。
935: 5. 检查 CP RX buffer是否在 NuttX copy完成前释放。
936: 6. 检查 reset后旧 descriptor。
937: 
938: ## 10. 风险和待确认事项
939: 
940: ### 10.1 不修改 CP 的固有限制
941: 
942: - Wire ABI 包含 32-bit pointer 和 Beken pbuf布局，不是独立于 OS 的稳定协议。
943: - CP 无 protocol version/epoch，跨版本和 reset 恢复能力有限。
944: - 数据面是否能向 NuttX 提供完整 Ethernet frame 取决于 CP 最终 VNET/filter 配置。
945: - CP/AP 共享 PSRAM 和 cache属性需要原厂资料或实测确认。
946: - 原厂 W1 的 ownership代码包含大量历史分支，必须以最终配置裁剪状态为准。
947: 
948: ### 10.2 量产前必须确认
